text: Figure 6.10: Information path for the EEPROM compare job error (for internal EEPROM) Note: EEPROM compare function is an internal mechanism for the EEPROM Abstrac- tion to determine whether erasing / writing is needed or not. Compare job error is detected by HW (1). EEPROM Driver is the first SW mod- ule involved, and is responsible for the report to the DEM and to the Flash EEPROM Emulation (2) which have to reset some internal states in order to accept new requests.
